headline: Oh Se-hoon and President Lee Clash at Cabinet Meeting: "Even with 'Strong Push,' There Are Principles" "An Attempt to Shake Policy"
summary: President Lee Jae-myung and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon disagreed over housing supply methods at a Cabinet meeting. The government proposed exempting public housing sites from the total greenbelt development-restricted zone.
why: Housing supply policy in Seoul affects property prices and construction activity in one of Asia's largest urban markets. Greenbelt rules restrict development on land around the city.
